number.says: Agriculture's share of the nitrogen carried by water from Danish land to Danish coastal waters in 2016-18, normalised to average runoff - as printed in Tabel 1 of Miljøstyrelsen's memo of 24 January 2023 to Folketinget. This project did not compute it and holds none of the stream records under it.
number.note: Each step below is theirs, shown in their words with an English translation. What this project adds is each step's kind, what it imposes, what else could have been chosen, whether it was tested, and what would settle it. No uncertainty is printed with the share in any document read. The memo took its table from the proposal for the third water plans; the final plans print 69.1% for the same years (rerun R2).

counted_as_one.what: One station = one fixed point on one stream, its samples one series for as long as it runs.
All land drawn upstream of a station = 'measured', however far from the station.
Land without a station = land like the gauged land of its region.
Every field in Denmark = the national field surplus of that year.
Everything not registered as a point source = diffuse.
All diffuse nitrogen not called background = agriculture.

records.published_by: Miljøstyrelsen, notat of 24 January 2023 (J.nr. 2023-4725), Tabel 1; sent to Folketinget as MOF Alm.del 2022-23 bilag 121
constructions_on_record: 'normaliserede': recomputed as if runoff had been average - not what arrived in any year (S13)
'landbaserede': from land, carried by water; the air and other countries' waters are not in the total (S12, S17)
'Landbrug' is a remainder, not a measurement (S14-S16)
the same 2016-18 period as the memo, in the final plans rather than the proposal

steps.title: Water is sampled about eighteen times a year at fixed stations
steps.imposes: What a stream carries between two sampling days is never seen: a flood that passes between them enters only through the straight line of S3. The stations are fixed points chosen by the programme.
steps.counted_as_one: One station = one fixed point on one stream, its samples one series for as long as it runs.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: Ved hovedparten af stoftransportstationerne måles med en frekvens på 18 prøver pr. år.
said.en: At most of the load stations, samples are taken at a frequency of 18 a year.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: Der er ligeledes gennemført en korrektion af total-kvælstof-data målt fra 2009 til 2015, da data for denne periode er analyseret med den samme forkerte metode
said.en: A correction has likewise been made to the total-nitrogen data measured from 2009 to 2015, as the data for that period were analysed with the same wrong method

steps.settle: Publish each station's sampling dates beside its discharge record, so a reader can see which floods were sampled and which were not.
steps.alternative: continuous sensors at some stations, as the 2018 field study used; sampling weighted towards high flow
steps.tested: in three streams, against daily measurement - see S3

steps.title: Discharge is computed from the logged water level
steps.imposes: The daily discharge comes from a relation between water level and flow, fitted to occasional gaugings - a model of the stream bed, refitted as the bed changes.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: indgår måledata fra i alt 244 vandføringsmålestationer
said.en: measurements from a total of 244 discharge stations are included

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: Den relative usikkerhed på opgørelsen af ferskvandsafstrømningen er størst i små oplande, hvor der ofte kun er en meget lille andel eller slet intet af arealet, der er dækket af målestationer.
said.en: The relative uncertainty of the freshwater runoff estimate is largest in small catchments, where often only a very small share of the area, or none of it, is covered by stations.

steps.settle: Publish the rating curves with their gaugings and the spread of the gaugings around them.
steps.alternative: direct velocity measurement at the station

steps.title: Between samples, the concentration is drawn as a straight line
steps.imposes: Each day's nitrogen is that day's discharge times a concentration drawn in a straight line between two samples up to six weeks apart. A flood's concentration is whatever the line says.

said.title: Bøgestrand & Erfurt (2014), Teknisk anvisning DB01: Stoftransport, Fagdatacenter for Ferskvand, DCE
said.da: Ved denne metode interpoleres der mellem årets koncentrationsmålinger af et givet stof for at generere døgnkoncentrationer.
said.en: In this method, the year's concentration measurements of a substance are interpolated to generate daily concentrations.

said.title: Bøgestrand & Erfurt (2014), Teknisk anvisning DB01: Stoftransport, Fagdatacenter for Ferskvand, DCE
said.da: Der må højst være 6 uger mellem to koncentrationsmålinger
said.en: There may be at most 6 weeks between two concentration measurements

said.title: van't Veen, Tornbjerg, Windolf, Kjeldgaard, Ovesen, Poulsen & Kronvang 2018, Hvordan måles kvælstof i vandløb? Vand & Jord 25(4), pages 169-173
said.da: I de 3 undersøgte vandløb blev den gennemsnitlige kvælstoftransport beregnet ud fra punktprøver dog altid underestimeret
said.en: In the 3 streams studied, however, the average nitrogen transport computed from grab samples was always underestimated

steps.settle: Apply the correction the study raised to the national loads, or publish why it is not needed.
steps.alternative: flow-weighted or regression estimators of load; the bias correction the 2018 study's authors raised
steps.tested: Yes: the 2018 study compared it with daily measurement in three streams and found it always low - on average by 0.9% in Jegstrup Bæk and by 7.7% in Odder Å with monthly sampling (rerun R3).

steps.title: The land upstream of the stations is drawn on a map and called measured
steps.imposes: A catchment map assigns land to stations. The 'measured share of the country' is an area on that map divided by the land area: nothing was sampled on that land, and it is not a share of the load or of the discharge. It moves when stations open and close.
steps.counted_as_one: All land drawn upstream of a station = 'measured', however far from the station.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.da: Det nye kortgrundlag er ID15v1.5, som består af >3100 deloplande med en middelstørrelse på ca. 15 km2.
said.en: The new map is ID15v1.5, which consists of more than 3100 sub-catchments with a mean size of about 15 km².

said.title: DCE (2011), Vandløb 2010. NOVANA. Videnskabelig rapport fra DCE nr. 4
said.da: Det areal, som derved er dækket af målestationer, er dermed reduceret fra 21 478 km2 til 21 131 km2, svarende til 49 % af Danmarks areal.
said.en: The area covered by stations is thereby reduced from 21,478 km² to 21,131 km², equal to 49% of Denmark's area.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: for 2017 og tidligere år indgik 169 målestationer, som dækkede et samlet opland på 24.380 km2, svarende til 57 % af landets samlede areal.
said.en: for 2017 and earlier years 169 stations were included, covering a total catchment of 24,380 km², equal to 57% of the country's total area.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: er der anvendt data fra i alt 235 målestationer dækkende et oplandsareal på 26.468 km2, hvilket svarer til ca. 62 % af landets samlede areal.
said.en: data from a total of 235 stations are used, covering a catchment area of 26,468 km², which equals about 62% of the country's total area.

steps.settle: Show the stations and the land drawn to each on a map, with the modelled land visibly blank, instead of one national share.
steps.alternative: report the load per station catchment as measured, and the modelled land separately - never as a share of a country

steps.title: Months without samples are filled in
steps.imposes: A station that closed, or opened late, still contributes a full series; its missing months are model output, not measurements.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: For 144 af de 235 målestationer er der ikke kontinuerte måledata for hele perioden.
said.en: For 144 of the 235 stations there are no continuous measurements for the whole period.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: Den valgte metode hertil er beskrevet i Windolf m.fl. (2013).
said.en: The method chosen for this is described in Windolf et al. (2013).

steps.settle: Publish, per year, the share of the national total that rests on filled-in months.
steps.alternative: use only measured months and report how much of each year rests on filled ones

steps.title: Runoff from land without stations comes from the national water model
steps.imposes: Where there is no gauge, the water is the DK-model's water. Its error in land with gauges is assumed to hold in land without them.
steps.counted_as_one: Land without a station = land like the gauged land of its region.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.da: afstrømninger fra det umålte opland (afstrømning fra områder uden målestationer) nu opgøres på basis af modellerede afstrømninger fra GEUSs DK-model (den nationale vandresourcemodel)
said.en: runoff from the unmeasured land (runoff from areas without stations) is now computed from modelled runoff from GEUS's DK-model (the national water resources model)

said.title: DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 527, Vandløb 2021. NOVANA
said.da: Da der ikke er målt afstrømning i umålt opland, kan disse steder dog ikke identificeres med metoden
said.en: As no runoff is measured in the unmeasured land, however, these places [where the model's error differs from that in gauged land] cannot be identified with the method

steps.settle: Gauge a sample of unmeasured catchments for a few years and publish the model's error there.
steps.alternative: temporary gauging in a sample of unmeasured catchments
steps.tested: Not possible with the method, by their own statement.

steps.title: Nitrogen in land without stations: a regression fitted to farm catchments
steps.imposes: The monthly concentration in land without stations is what a regression on soil, farming share, drainage, rain, temperature and the national field surplus predicts.
inputs: maps of soil, land use and drainage

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: Modellen har en samlet forklaringsgrad på 43 % for perioden 1990-2007.
said.en: The model has an overall explanatory power of 43% for 1990-2007.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: simulerer måledata fra en række målte oplande tilfredsstillende
said.en: simulates measured data from a number of measured catchments satisfactorily

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: Derfor anvendes modellen til en vis grad uden for dens modeldomæne.
said.en: The model is therefore used, to some extent, outside its model domain.

steps.settle: Publish the model's error on held-out catchments as a range on the unmeasured land's load.

why.reason: It reproduces measured catchments it was not calibrated on, in their judgement.
why.author: DCE (MSFD notat 2.8, 2012)

steps.alternative: report the unmeasured land's load as a range from the measured catchments' spread
steps.tested: against gauged catchments, in their words 'satisfactorily'; the fit explains 43% of what it was fitted to

steps.title: One national field surplus a year stands for every field
steps.imposes: The field surplus - itself computed as nitrogen applied minus harvested, from norms, not measured - enters as one number for the whole country each year. It carries the trend over time, not the differences between places, and it ties the modelled load to the farm accounts the share is then used to judge.
steps.counted_as_one: Every field in Denmark = the national field surplus of that year.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: En vigtig modelvariabel i DK-QNPv2-modellen til beregning af tilførsel af totalt diffust kvælstof fra umålt opland er det beregnede årlige nationale kvælstofoverskud på mark-niveau (markbalancen).
said.en: An important variable in the DK-QNPv2 model for computing the diffuse nitrogen from unmeasured land is the calculated annual national nitrogen surplus at field level (the field balance).

steps.settle: Show how the modelled load changes with the surplus left out - how much of the modelled farm load is the surplus itself.

steps.title: The model is scaled to match the stations of its region
steps.imposes: Month by month, the modelled concentrations are multiplied by the ratio of measured to modelled at full-series stations in the same region, so the unmeasured land follows the measured land's trend by construction.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.da: Forskelle i koncentration mellem målte og modellerede værdier ses som en generel model-bias, som det er rimeligt at korrigere.
said.en: Differences in concentration between measured and modelled values are seen as a general model bias, which it is reasonable to correct.

steps.settle: The same held-out gauging as S6 would test it.

why.reason: The differences between measured and modelled are taken as a general bias.
why.author: DCE (Vandløb 2018)

steps.alternative: leave the model uncorrected and show both
steps.tested: not tested: it assumes the bias in measured land is the bias in unmeasured land (see S6)

steps.title: Nitrogen removed in lakes and streams is calculated and subtracted
steps.imposes: Removal rates per hectare of stream, lake and wetland, averaged from the literature, are applied throughout the unmeasured land.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: Nettoudledninger fra de umålte oplande fastlægges ved at fratrække en beregnet retention i de enkelte umålte oplande.
said.en: The net discharges from the unmeasured catchments are found by subtracting a calculated retention in each unmeasured catchment.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: der må forventes at være en betydelig usikkerhed på de beregnede kvælstofretentioner i vandløb
said.en: a considerable uncertainty must be expected in the calculated nitrogen retentions in streams

steps.settle: Publish the retention subtracted, in tonnes a year, with a range.
steps.alternative: report the gross load and the retention separately
steps.tested: No numeric uncertainty was found for this retention. The range of 6-27 percentage points often quoted belongs to the National Nitrogen Model's retention from root zone to coast: a different model and quantity.

steps.title: What counts as a point source, and as a direct discharge
steps.imposes: A register decides which outlets are point sources - plants, industry, fish farms, overflows - and a distance rule decides which reach the sea directly. Missing early years are filled with the earliest known value.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.where: the rule for a direct discharge
said.da: koordinaterne for udledningspunktet enten ligger ude i havet eller på land højst 100 meter fra kystlinjen
said.en: the coordinates of the discharge point lie either out at sea or on land at most 100 metres from the coastline

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.da: er det antaget, at udledningerne har været af samme størrelse som den tidligst kendte udledning
said.en: it is assumed that the discharges were the same size as the earliest known discharge

steps.settle: Publish how much of each year's point-source total is filled rather than reported.

steps.title: The total: measured, plus modelled, plus direct discharges
steps.imposes: The total is the nitrogen carried from Danish land by water. What comes through the air, from other countries' rivers and seas, or up from the sea floor is outside it by definition.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: Målte stoftransport (målt opland) + beregnet nettotransport fra umålt opland + direkte spildevandsudledninger til pågældende kystafsnit.
said.en: Measured transport (measured land) + calculated net transport from unmeasured land + direct wastewater discharges to the coastal section concerned.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: på henholdsvis 20-25 % og ca. 20 %
said.en: of 20-25% and about 20% respectively [the uncertainty of the total annual input of nitrogen and of phosphorus via streams and direct discharges]

steps.settle: Print the total with the 20-25% uncertainty their own 2012 note gives, wherever the share is printed.
steps.alternative: a total that includes deposition and inflow from other seas

steps.title: Each year is recomputed as if runoff had been average
steps.imposes: The published tonnes are not what arrived in any year but what a model says would have arrived at average runoff; three such years, 2016-18, are averaged.

said.title: Miljøstyrelsen, notat af 24. januar 2023 (J.nr. 2023-4725), Udledning af kvælstof til kystvand opdelt på kilder. Folketinget, MOF Alm.del 2022-23 (2. samling), bilag 121
said.da: Med henblik på i videst muligt omfang at korrigere for variation i nedbør og afstrømning beregnes, hvad der ville forventes, hvis vandafstrømningen havde været den samme fra år til år
said.en: To correct as far as possible for variation in rain and runoff, what would be expected if runoff had been the same from year to year is computed

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.da: fitte en lineær model til logaritme transformerede månedstransporter og månedsvandafstrømninger
said.en: fit a linear model to log-transformed monthly transports and monthly runoffs

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2019, Vandløbsdata og kvælstoftransport, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 353
said.da: den anvendte normaliseringsmetode ikke tager højde for alle effekter af vejret på dyrkningen
said.en: the normalisation method used does not account for all effects of the weather on farming

steps.settle: Print the actual 2016-18 loads next to the normalised ones.

why.reason: So that a wet year and a dry year can be compared.
why.author: Miljøstyrelsen (notat 2023)

steps.alternative: report the actual loads beside the normalised ones

steps.title: Diffuse = the total minus the point sources
steps.imposes: Whatever is in the water and not in the point-source register is called diffuse: errors in the total, gaps in the register and every source with no register all land in this remainder.
steps.counted_as_one: Everything not registered as a point source = diffuse.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: beregnes et diffust bidrag fra det åbne land som differencen mellem punktkildebidraget og den samlede transport.
said.en: a diffuse contribution from the open land is calculated as the difference between the point-source contribution and the total transport.

said.title: Thodsen et al. 2025, Vand- og Næringsstoftransport 2024. NOVANA, DCE Videnskabelig rapport nr. 681
said.da: Spildevand fra spredt bebyggelse henregnes i denne opgørelse til det diffuse bidrag.
said.en: Wastewater from scattered housing is counted as diffuse in this account.

steps.settle: Carry the total's uncertainty and the register's gaps through to the diffuse figure.
steps.alternative: estimate each diffuse source directly and report what is left over as unexplained

steps.title: The natural background is estimated from a few near-natural streams
steps.imposes: Nobody measures what farmed land would yield without farming. Concentrations from a few streams with little farming are spread over the country on a grid and multiplied by runoff; this is the stand-in.
inputs: a 5x5 km grid by landscape type

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: som bestemmes i mindre oplande med lav antropogen påvirkning
said.en: which is determined in smaller catchments with little human influence

said.title: Bøgestrand, Kronvang, Windolf & Kjeldgaard (DCE notat, 16.12.2014), Baggrundsbelastning med total N og nitrat-N - opdatering
said.da: Ved beregning af en baggrundsbelastning fra et givet opland skal den arealvægtede baggrundskoncentration i oplandet multipliceres med en vandafstrømning
said.en: To compute a background load from a given catchment, the area-weighted background concentration in the catchment is multiplied by a runoff

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: baggrundsbidraget er dog sandsynligvis påvirket af en forhøjet atmosfærisk deposition
said.en: the background contribution is, however, probably affected by elevated deposition from the air

steps.settle: Publish the background as a range and carry it to the share: every tonne moved out of the background moves the same tonne into agriculture.
steps.alternative: a range of backgrounds, from the lowest to the highest near-natural streams, carried to the share

steps.title: Agriculture = the diffuse remainder minus the background
steps.imposes: Only two terms: once the background is taken out, all that remains is called agriculture - including the errors of every earlier step and every unregistered source. In the 2016-18 tables scattered housing is a separate row, so the 2012 definition quoted here is not exactly the one used.
steps.counted_as_one: All diffuse nitrogen not called background = agriculture.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: Diffuse tilførsler (inkl. spredt bebyggelse) minus baggrundsbidraget (diffus antropogen)
said.en: Diffuse inputs (incl. scattered housing) minus the background contribution (diffuse anthropogenic)

said.title: Miljøministeriet (juni 2023), Vandområdeplanerne 2021-2027 (the edition dated 22.9.2023)
said.da: Den diffuse belastning fra landarealer udgøres af et baggrundsbidrag og et landbrugsbidrag.
said.en: The diffuse load from land consists of a background contribution and an agricultural contribution.

said.title: Miljøministeriet (juni 2023), Vandområdeplanerne 2021-2027 (the edition dated 22.9.2023)
said.da: Den altovervejende kilde til den diffuse kvælstoftransport i vandløbene er tabet af kvælstof fra de dyrkede arealer.
said.en: By far the main source of the diffuse nitrogen transport in streams is the loss of nitrogen from cultivated land.

said.title: DCE Havstrategi-notat 2-8, tilførsel af N, P og organisk stof
said.da: retentionen alene er lagt på det diffuse antropogene bidrag
said.en: the retention is laid on the diffuse anthropogenic contribution alone

steps.settle: Test the agricultural load against leaching measured under fields rather than by subtraction, and print the share with a range.

why.reason: Cultivated land is taken to be by far the main diffuse source.
why.author: Miljøministeriet (Vandområdeplanerne 2021-2027)

steps.alternative: name the remainder 'diffuse, not background', and give agriculture a range from direct estimates such as leaching measured under fields
steps.tested: not tested directly: a remainder can only be checked against something measured independently

steps.title: Divided by the land-based total, and carried to later years
steps.imposes: The denominator is the land-based, normalised total of 2016-18, 56,300 tonnes. Deposition from the air - which the water plans put at about 74,000 tonnes a year on Danish coastal and territorial waters - is not in it. The share is printed to one decimal with no uncertainty, and assumed to hold for 2021.

said.title: Miljøstyrelsen, notat af 24. januar 2023 (J.nr. 2023-4725), Udledning af kvælstof til kystvand opdelt på kilder. Folketinget, MOF Alm.del 2022-23 (2. samling), bilag 121
said.da: Tabel 1. Den procentvise kildefordeling af den landbaserede normaliserede kvælstoftilførsel fra Danmark til kystområderne.
said.en: Table 1. The percentage distribution by source of the land-based, normalised nitrogen input from Denmark to the coastal areas.

said.title: Miljøstyrelsen, notat af 24. januar 2023 (J.nr. 2023-4725), Udledning af kvælstof til kystvand opdelt på kilder. Folketinget, MOF Alm.del 2022-23 (2. samling), bilag 121
said.da: Fordelingen af den normaliserede udledning af kvælstof med udgangspunkt i forslag til Vandområdeplan 3 er anført i tabel 1 nedenfor.
said.en: The distribution of the normalised nitrogen discharge, based on the proposal for Water Plan 3, is given in table 1 below.

said.title: Miljøstyrelsen, notat af 24. januar 2023 (J.nr. 2023-4725), Udledning af kvælstof til kystvand opdelt på kilder. Folketinget, MOF Alm.del 2022-23 (2. samling), bilag 121
said.da: antages det i dette notat, at tallene for den mere differentierede fordeling af kvælstofbelastningen på enkelte kilder fra 2016-18 er retningsangivende for belastningen i 2021.
said.en: this memo assumes that the figures for the more detailed distribution of the nitrogen load among sources in 2016-18 are indicative of the load in 2021.

steps.settle: Print it as a share of the nitrogen carried by water from Danish land, with its range, wherever it is printed - never as a share of 'the nitrogen'.

why.reason: The total and the split between diffuse and point sources in 2021 did not differ much from the five years before, in their judgement.
why.author: Miljøstyrelsen (notat 2023)

steps.alternative: a denominator including deposition and inflow from other seas (reruns R1a, R1b)

ends.author: Miljøstyrelsen

ends.author: Miljøministeriet

ends.author: the monitoring programme's data centres

ends.what: A total that counts only nitrogen carried by water from Danish land
ends.author: the accounts' definition

ends.what: The two-term split of diffuse nitrogen into background and agriculture
ends.author: the accounts' definition

ends.what: The DK-model's runoff where there is no gauge

notes.model_output: Over the land without stations the load is model output at every step: runoff (S6), concentration (S7-S9) and retention (S10). The background (S15) is model output everywhere, and every published tonne is normalised (S13).

spread.what: The same share in the four river-basin districts, from the final water plans' Tabel 3.28 (2016-18). They range from 55.6% to 84.3%; weighted by each district's load they give 67.8%, but the table prints 69.1% for the country (the background column likewise mixes to 22.4% against 22.1% printed). The table does not say how its national column was computed.
spread.note: District IV is the Danish part of the river basin shared with Germany. Below the districts the plans work per coastal catchment; those shares are not in the documents read.

kinds.selection: which records count: filters, sample types, complete years
kinds.identity: what counts as the same thing
kinds.convention: thresholds and definitions: bottom water, a limit, a boundary
kinds.correction: a model applied to the value itself
kinds.filling in: interpolation, model output where nothing was measured
kinds.functional form: the shape assumed: linear, a retention model, a fitted curve
kinds.attribution: assigning a remainder to one cause

regions.title: Stream monitoring
regions.theory: The nitrogen a stream carries past a station is its discharge times its concentration, summed day by day. Discharge follows from a logged water level; concentration is sampled on some days, and the days between are filled in by a straight line.
caveats: What passes between two sampling days, a flood for instance, is known only through the line.
A station is one fixed point on one stream.

regions.title: Catchment accounting
regions.theory: The land drawn upstream of a station on a catchment map is taken to be represented by it: what the station measures is what that land delivers.
caveats: The 'measured share of the country' is an area ratio on a map, not a share of anything sampled, and it moves as stations open and close.

regions.title: Modelling the land without stations
regions.theory: Where no stream is gauged the load is computed: runoff from the national water model, a concentration from a regression fitted to gauged farm catchments, scaled to agree with the gauged stations of the same region, minus the nitrogen calculated to be removed in lakes, streams and wetlands.
caveats: The model's error in gauged land is assumed to be its error in ungauged land, which the method cannot check (S6).
The regression is used partly outside its domain, by their own statement (S7).
The national field surplus is one of its inputs, so the modelled load is partly the farm accounts themselves (S8).

regions.title: Point-source registers
regions.theory: Registered outlets - treatment plants, industry, fish farms, overflows - are counted from their own measurements or from unit loads, and a rule of distance decides which discharge straight to the sea.
caveats: Missing early years are filled with the earliest known value (S11).

regions.title: Load accounts
regions.theory: The land-based total is the measured load plus the modelled load plus the direct discharges; each year is then recomputed as if runoff had been average, and 2016-18 are averaged.
caveats: Only nitrogen carried from Danish land by water is in the total.
The published tonnes are normalised: not what arrived in any year.

regions.title: Residual source apportionment
regions.theory: A source's share is found by subtraction: what no register accounts for is diffuse; what of the diffuse is not the natural background is agriculture; agriculture over the land-based total is the share.
caveats: A remainder collects the errors of every step before it and every source that has no register.
No uncertainty is published for the background or for the share.

nodes.label: The stream itself
nodes.what: Not a record: what the samples are taken from. Everything above it is what was recorded of it, and what was computed from that.

nodes.label: Grab samples · total nitrogen
nodes.what: Bottles of stream water analysed for total nitrogen at fixed stations, held in the national database (ODA).
caveats: Not held by this project.
Results for 2009-2015 were corrected for a wrong analysis method (S1).

nodes.label: Logged water levels · gaugings
nodes.what: The water level logged at each gauge, and occasional direct measurements of flow.
caveats: Not held by this project.

nodes.label: Daily discharge per station
nodes.what: Water flow per day, from the logged level through a relation between level and flow.
caveats: Largest relative uncertainty in small catchments (S2).

nodes.label: Nitrogen load per station per day
nodes.what: The day's discharge times a concentration drawn in a straight line between two samples.
caveats: Always low against daily measurement in the three streams of the 2018 study (S3).

nodes.label: Station series · gaps filled
nodes.what: Each station's series over the whole period, its months without samples computed.
caveats: Most stations have no continuous record (S5).

nodes.label: ID15 catchment map
nodes.what: Sub-catchments of about 15 km², drawn so that land can be assigned to stations and lakes.

nodes.label: Load from 'measured' land
nodes.what: The station loads, standing for all the land drawn upstream of the stations.
caveats: Nothing was sampled on that land itself (S4).

nodes.label: DK-model (GEUS)
nodes.what: The national hydrological model's runoff.

nodes.label: Runoff · land without stations
nodes.what: Monthly runoff for ungauged land, from the DK-model, corrected by region.
caveats: Where its error differs from gauged land cannot be identified (S6).

nodes.label: Soil, farming, drainage · weather
nodes.what: The regression's explanatory variables: soil type, share cultivated, share drained, monthly rain and temperature.

nodes.label: Farm nitrogen accounts
nodes.what: Nitrogen applied minus nitrogen harvested, computed from norms, not measured.

nodes.label: National field surplus · one number a year
nodes.what: The farm accounts as one national figure per year, the same for every ungauged catchment.
caveats: Carries the trend over time, not the differences between places (S8).

nodes.label: Modelled concentration · land without stations
nodes.what: The regression's monthly nitrogen concentration for each ungauged sub-catchment.
caveats: The fit explains less than half of what it was fitted to (S7).

nodes.label: Concentration scaled to the region's stations
nodes.what: The modelled concentration multiplied, month by month, by the ratio of measured to modelled at the region's full-series stations.
caveats: Follows the measured land's trend by construction (S9).

nodes.label: Lakes, streams, wetlands · literature rates
nodes.what: Areas of water where nitrogen is removed, with removal rates per hectare averaged from the literature.

nodes.label: Net load · land without stations
nodes.what: Runoff times concentration, minus the calculated removal.
caveats: No numeric uncertainty is published for the removal (S10).

nodes.label: Point-source registers
nodes.what: Metered effluent from plants and industry; unit loads for scattered housing, overflows and some fish farms.
caveats: Part measured, part modelled (S11).

nodes.label: Point-source load
nodes.what: Nitrogen from the registered outlets.

nodes.label: Land-based total
nodes.what: Measured load + modelled net load + direct discharges, per coastal section and year.
caveats: The only published uncertainty found is for the total, in the 2012 note (S12).

nodes.label: Normalised total 2016-18 · 56,300 t
nodes.what: The yearly totals recomputed at average runoff, averaged over three years.
caveats: Not what arrived in any year (S13).

nodes.label: Diffuse load
nodes.what: The total minus the registered point sources: everything in the water that no register accounts for.
caveats: 'Diffuse' means 'not in a register', not 'from fields' (S14).

nodes.label: Near-natural streams
nodes.what: Concentrations measured in a few streams with little farming, the stand-in for land without people.
caveats: Fewer streams in 2011 than in 2004-5, which weakens the statistics, by their own note.

nodes.label: Natural background
nodes.what: Background concentrations spread over the country on a grid by landscape type, times runoff.
caveats: Probably raised by nitrogen from the air, by their own note (S15).

nodes.label: Agriculture
nodes.what: The diffuse load minus the background: the remainder, named agriculture.
caveats: Holds the errors of every step before it and every source with no register (S16).

nodes.label: 69.6% · agriculture's share
nodes.what: Agriculture over the normalised land-based total, as printed in Tabel 1 of Miljøstyrelsen's memo of 24 January 2023.
caveats: The final water plans print 69.1% for the same years (R2).
Deposition from the air is not in the denominator; with it, 30.1% (R1a).
